equations: For constant rate r over duration T: x(T)=x0*exp(-T/tau)+alpha*r*tau*(1-exp(-T/tau)); after shutoff x(t)=x(T)*exp(-(t-T)/tau).

For x0<=xc and monotone x rising from below, qdot source is zero until crossing, and q is frozen at that crossing; therefore q(t)=q0*exp(-kd*min(t,tc)) if crossing occurs, otherwise q0*exp(-kd*t). This is a mathematical consequence of the original rule, pending C5 broker arithmetic.
